name: Protect a Friend
desc:
🌙 Survive the Night, Rebuild the Bridge!

When darkness falls, only one player stays awake — the Protector.
Everyone else sleeps, counting on you to survive until dawn.

🏕️ Light the campfire to unlock new upgrades
⚒️ Gather materials to strengthen your defenses
🌉 Contribute resources each night to rebuild the bridge to safety
👹 Face stronger monsters as the nights progress
💀 If the Protector dies, the entire team loses the night

Remember: the longer you last, the closer you get to escaping together ⭐
